verdict.rationale: Rollbar hosts a live llms.txt at docs.rollbar.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, confirmed via probe) and also provides agent-oriented docs for its MCP server setup, directly enabling an agent to be pointed at machine-readable documentation. missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of llms.txt usage in the wild, and no evidence of additional agent-friendly formats (e.g., structured API schemas, since openapi.json returned 404s).
